summary: Iteration 3 frontend verification for SAP WM TO Processor. Tested Ringkasan Dataset legend, new batch sizes (3/4/5/6/10/15), card metric chips (Total Qty, Avg Bin/TO), 5-column conditional table when a card is selected, Mixed Row sub-filter chip bar with count badges, sub-filter caption updates, copy-to-clipboard button pulse + rich Sonner toast, Reset Filter / Reset Data Sampel flows. All 14 acceptance criteria pass. No React console errors observed.
verified_features: dataset-summary shows Total TO=12, Article=17, Row=16, Bin=17, Qty=86 (matches mock spec)
batch-size buttons 3,4,5,6,10,15 all present; switching to 4 regenerates 26 cards
card-metrics-1..N and card-metrics-mixed chips render with Total Qty and Avg Bin/TO values (mixed shows Qty=22, AvgBin=5)
Clicking card-batch-3 filters table to TO 5330147 with 5 columns (No | TO | Total Bin=2 | Total Qty=9 | Row Spread badges 12,15)
Table renders only No + Transfer Order Number when no card selected (after Reset Filter)
Mixed card reveals mixed-subfilter-bar with 6 chip buttons and correct counts: Semua Mixed=1, 2 Row=0, 3 Row=0, 4 Row=1, 5 Row=0, >5 Row=0
4 Row filter shows TO 5330146 with row spread 07/08/10/17; 2 Row and >5 Row show empty state 'Tidak ada Transfer Order Number...'
Sub-filter caption updates correctly: 'tepat 4 Row', 'lebih dari 5 Row', 'tepat 2 Row', '(semua)'
Switching from Mixed card to card-batch-3 hides subfilter bar (resets subfilter to all)
Copy TO Unik ke SAP: button pulses to 'Tersalin!' for ~1.4s and reverts; clipboard populated with unique TO numbers; sonner toast text includes 'Ctrl + V' / 'Tersalin'
Reset Data Sampel restores 17 mock records / Total TO=12
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~1210 lines — approaching size where a split into hooks + components would improve maintainability (dataset summary, batchStats, mixed subfilter logic could be extracted).

Empty state message renders as a single tbody row with colspan; this is fine but Playwright rowCount for empty state = 1 could confuse future tests — consider giving the empty-state row its own data-testid (e.g. 'empty-state-row').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 additions (Ringkasan Dataset, batch sizes 4 & 6, per-card metric chips, 5-column table on card click, mixed sub-filter chip bar with reset-on-card-switch, copy button pulse + rich toast) verified against acceptance criteria and pass. No regressions in Reset Filter / Reset Data Sampel. Upload flow deliberately not re-tested per E1 note.
